t: Section 2(b)(9)(B)(iii) of the Export-Import Bank Act of 1945 (12 U.S.C. 635(b)(9)(B)(iii)) is amended by striking “2011” and inserting “2014”.

fable.w: On its face this section only changes a date in an existing provision of the Export-Import Bank Act; it sets out no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government. The tempting reading is that the amended provision may extend the life of an advisory committee (from memory, this clause sets the termination date of the Bank's sub-Saharan Africa advisory committee), but the section's own text describes no outside-party process. Being conservative, a bare date substitution is not labelled as participation.
fable.s: is amended by striking “2011” and inserting “2014”

opus.w: The section only changes a date in a cross-referenced provision of the Export-Import Bank Act. It names no outside party and no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body or right to sue. One could argue it extends an advisory committee with outside members by pushing back its end date. But nothing in the section's text sets up or describes participation by anyone outside the federal government.
opus.s: is amended by striking “2011” and inserting “2014”
opus.b:
I labelled this **No**, though with only moderate confidence.

- **Tempting reading:** Section 2(b)(9) of the Export-Import Bank Act is, as I recall, about the Bank's Sub-Saharan Africa Advisory Committee, which includes private-sector members. If clause (iii) is that committee's termination date, changing 2011 to 2014 would keep an outside advisory body running for three more years, which would count as participation.
- **Why I rejected it:** That depends on outside knowledge I can't confirm from the section itself. The text only changes a date. It names no outside party and no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking or right to sue. Read on its face, there is no participation.

If clause (iii) really is that committee's sunset date, the label should probably be Yes, which is why my confidence is low.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a technical amendment that changes a specific year reference in the Export-Import Bank Act. It does not create, require, or describe any process for consultation, coordination, or participation with entities outside the federal government. There is no mention of public comment, advisory committees, or interaction with states, tribes, or the public.
qwen_chat.s: Section 2(b)(9)(B)(iii) of the Export-Import Bank Act of 1945 (12 U.S.C. 635(b)(9)(B)(iii)) is amended by striking “2011” and inserting “2014”.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that changing a date in a statute could implicitly affect participation requirements if that date was tied to a comment period or hearing. However, the text itself is merely a technical amendment to a fiscal year or deadline reference within the Export-Import Bank Act. It does not establish, modify, or reference any process for consulting with outside parties, holding public hearings, or creating advisory bodies. It is a standalone legislative change to a numerical value.
